summary: The team is in a promotion push for Asia Star and Intelligent China while closing out the Knowledge website redesign and clearing a lingering Outlook lockout that's blocking daily work.
summaryDetail: The biggest initiative in motion is the marketing strategy for Asia Star and Intelligent China, now confirmed as the top two promotion priorities with Berkeley as a possible third; Joseph owes an SEO target-areas document and the team owes both a brief and an audit of conversion tracking, so that work needs to move this week. The Knowledge website redesign is nearly settled: the team is keeping the current design with menu categorization changes, dispersing videos by topic, adding BCI/BSI indices and card-based document types, and dropping the stock ticker—Joseph needs to share the HTML concept and the team lead, Julie and Joseph should hold the 30-minute feedback session so Joker can make final changes. On the operational side, an Outlook account lockout from stale saved passwords on multiple devices is still open and needs the team to re-login across laptops and phones and confirm a backend unlock with CKGSB IT. Looking ahead, ESG report drafting and the Nov 13 CKGSB x European Chamber event alignment are on the runway, along with the Yili Group digitalization enquiry and the AACSB 2027 Global Impact Award application already submitted.
